themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can perform research tasks autonomously or with minimal human intervention.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, debug, and understand code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers a broad range of AI applications designed to assist in various research activities, from data analysis to literature review.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Articles detailing how AI is used to analyze large datasets, extract insights, and identify patterns.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Content related to AI's ability to condense large amounts of text into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Examines how AI tools and techniques are being applied to enhance or automate aspects of the design and research process.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Research and discussion on how AI is affecting job roles, employment, and the future of work.

themes.name: AI ethics in research
themes.description: Explores the ethical considerations and challenges associated with using AI in research and user studies.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that compare, review, or assess the performance and utility of various AI tools.

themes.name: Conversational AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI chatbots and conversational agents used for user interviews, data collection, or user interaction analysis.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
